name: adform-mcp
description: Adform FLOW (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_adform_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADFORM_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_adform_client_id.description: Client id of an Adform API client enabled for the client-credentials flow (requested from Adform support; https://api.adform.com/help/guides/getting-started/authorization-guide).

platform_mcp_adform_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADFORM_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_adform_client_secret.description: The client's secret, sent in the form body of POST https://id.adform.com/sts/connect/token; the client must be granted the buyer.advertisers.readonly and buyer.campaigns.api.readonly scopes. Tokens last about an hour and are re-requested automatically.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/buyer/advertisers?limit=1: confirms the client credentials and scopes (Adform has no who-am-i endpoint).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v1/buyer/advertisers (offset/limit): the advertisers the client can access, active and inactive ({id, name, timeZone, status}); no currency on this record.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /v1/buyer/campaigns?advertisers={account_id} (offset/limit). `status` is Active or Inactive; without it Adform returns only active campaigns. `budget` is the campaign's planning budget (total, not daily) in `currency`.
